commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1
EXPECTED_MAIN=4f5c261301b865ea4af1bbb8d274c7dbd469d707
ACTUAL_MAIN="$(gh api repos/MichalMatu/ai-calls/branches/main --jq '.commit.sha')"
test "$ACTUAL_MAIN" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN" || { echo "MAIN_MOVED_HOLD=true"; exit 40; }
DIR="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-prune-branches-XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$DIR"' EXIT
gh api --paginate repos/MichalMatu/ai-calls/branches --jq '.[].name' | sort -u > "$DIR/branches"
echo "BRANCH_COUNT_BEFORE=$(wc -l < "$DIR/branches" | tr -d ' ')"
for x in main agent-control fix/release-wireless-adb-20261123; do grep -Fxq "$x" "$DIR/branches"; done
OPEN="$(gh pr list -R MichalMatu/ai-calls --state open --json number --jq 'length')"
test "$OPEN" = 0 || { echo "OPEN_PR_STOP=true"; exit 41; }
COUNT=0
while IFS= read -r b; do
 case "$b" in main|agent-control|fix/release-wireless-adb-20261123) continue;; esac
 echo "DELETE_BRANCH=$b"
 gh api -X DELETE "repos/MichalMatu/ai-calls/git/refs/heads/$b" >/dev/null
 COUNT=$((COUNT+1))
done < "$DIR/branches"
echo "OLD_BRANCHES_DELETED=$COUNT"
gh api --paginate repos/MichalMatu/ai-calls/branches --jq '.[].name' | sort -u > "$DIR/after"
echo "BRANCH_COUNT_AFTER=$(wc -l < "$DIR/after" | tr -d ' ')"
test "$(wc -l < "$DIR/after" | tr -d ' ')" -eq 3
for x in main agent-control fix/release-wireless-adb-20261123; do grep -Fxq "$x" "$DIR/after"; done
echo "OLD_BRANCH_CLEANUP_PASS=true"
